final: WITH c AS (SELECT r.circuitId AS circuitId, ci.country AS country, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM races r JOIN circuits ci ON ci.circuitId = r.circuitId WHERE r.date >= '1978-03-04' AND r.date <= '2003-03-09' GROUP BY r.circuitId, ci.country) SELECT circuitId, country, cnt AS race_count, cnt * 1.0 / AVG(cnt) OVER (PARTITION BY country) AS ratio FROM c ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 10
